meta.name: add-linear
meta.description: Add Linear channel integration via Chat SDK. Issue comment threads as conversations.

copy.tagline: 将 Linear 工单评论转为聊天会话
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果团队用 Linear 管理任务并希望直接在聊天中跟进评论。
copy.tagline_en: Turn Linear issue comments into chat conversations
copy.fit_line_en: For you if your team uses Linear for task management and wants to follow up comments in chat.

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 能接入 Linear,自动参与 issue 评论区。每个 issue 的每条评论都会触发 Claude 回复,无需 @ 提及;每个 issue 的讨论串形成独立会话。
howto.when: 当被监控的 Linear 团队中的任意 issue 出现新评论时,Claude 会自动接话,不需要 @ 提及。

say.text: 请总结这个 issue 的讨论要点。
say.note: Claude 会读取评论串并汇总。

say.text: 这个 bug 的根因是什么?
say.note: Claude 根据评论区内容作答。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can join Linear issue comment threads. Every comment on a monitored issue triggers a response without needing an @mention, and each issue's comment thread becomes a separate conversation.
howto.when_en: The skill triggers whenever a new comment is posted on any issue in the configured Linear team. Claude responds automatically; no @mention is needed.

say_en.text: Please summarize the discussion points of this issue.
say_en.note: Claude reads the thread and provides a summary.

say_en.text: What is the root cause of this bug?
say_en.note: Claude answers based on the comments.
